notes: 24 completed checkpoint evaluations, 72 audit rows. 6 checkpoint evaluations reuse Phase I models; these are not additional independent runs.
All raw arrays, reported summary metrics, nested random and strong gains, and local profile/input hashes pass independent consistency checks.
Author directory labels 0/1/2 are not verified fresh training seeds. Source checkpoint hashes differ; report across-checkpoint sample SD.
All three GemNet selected models are all-null before and after transformation; zero regret and constraint validity are vacuous, not evidence of successful GemNet replication.
GemNet trained 20,000 steps but its validator selected step 100 in all seeds because qualified checks had zero revenue while later positive-revenue checks were incompatible.
All GemNet 49 context transformation calls per seed were zero-violation skips with zero price adjustments, so no nontrivial repair by MILP was demonstrated.
GemNet source is an independent paper-based implementation; do not attribute this failure to the published algorithm or remove it silently.
Main tables should stratify 3x10 vs 2x2 and fresh reimplementations vs author checkpoints; publish GemNet failure in separate diagnostics.

No full rerun is necessary to report the completed nondegenerate experiments. A valid GemNet performance comparison requires a targeted repaired training/selection/transform experiment before such a claim.
Regret is a finite-search lower bound, PMR denominator is profile-bidder pairs at threshold 1e-6, and near-zero regret is not continuous-domain DSIC certification.
Reported max-regret mean±SD is across unit-specific maxima; it is not the maximum over all units. A paper table must label the aggregation explicitly.
